payload.comment:
The reporting stage is internally consistent and all arithmetic cross-checks pass. Verification: (1) Confusion matrix rows sum to per-class supports (total 7,180); accuracy 6,375/7,180 = 0.887883 ✓; macro-F1, macro-precision, macro-recall, balanced accuracy all mutually consistent ✓. (2) Abstention report: test_coverage 0.560724 = 1 − 0.439276 ✓; selective_risk 0.026826 = 1 − 0.973174 ✓; human_review_count 3154 = 7180 × 0.439276 ✓; ood_auroc 0.979091 = mean of three predictive_entropy test AUROCs ✓; ood_validation_auroc 0.999483 = mean of three validation AUROCs ✓. (3) Comparison: accuracy_delta 0.066574 = 0.887883 − 0.821309 ✓; common_seed 42 and split_fingerprint 9afc9ed3… identical in both reports ✓; baseline_met_or_exceeded = true ✓. (4) Search: test_metrics_used = false ✓; 4 completed, 0 failed trials ✓. (5) Prediction artifact: 7,180 test + 10,004 validation samples, includes logits/probabilities/targets ✓.

No deterministic errors found. The reporting correctly aggregates all pipeline artefacts and surfaces the key concerns through anomaly reports. However, several warning-level concerns warrant attention before deployment:

1. Severe validation-to-test generalization gap: val_acc 0.9972 → test_acc 0.8879 (~11 pp); val_macro_f1 0.9972 → test_macro_f1 0.8555 (~14 pp). The selection criterion (validation accuracy 0.9827) does not reflect test performance, suggesting the selection rule may be unreliable for this split.
2. Cancer-associated stroma (class 7) critically underperforming: recall 0.508, F1 0.647; 105/421 misclassified as debris, 71 as smooth muscle. Smooth muscle (class 5): F1 0.705, recall 0.799. Debris (class 2) precision only 0.614.
3. Test abstention rate 43.9% vs. validation 20%: ~24 pp coverage drop from the 80% calibration target; nearly half of test predictions deferred to human review, operationally costly.
4. OOD evaluation limited to unit-scale Gaussian noise at 3 severity levels; does not cover semantic OOD shifts (tissue type variation, imaging artifacts, domain shift).
5. 17 artefacts omitted from the dossier (including best_configuration, train_config, all trial artefacts, search_plan, split_manifest, data_profile, run_manifest), reducing full auditability. Rationale strings in best_configuration and train_config are truncated (end with '…').
6. early_stopping_patience changed from 1 (search trials) to 3 (final training) without explicit in-rationale documentation.
7. reporting_status.complete_through_stage is 'comparison' rather than 'reporting'; while this may be by design (reporting is the aggregation step), it creates ambiguity about whether the reporting stage itself is marked complete.

The reporting stage fulfils its aggregation and cross-referencing role correctly. The flagged issues are model-quality and operational-readiness concerns that the reporting appropriately surfaces. Recommend addressing the generalization gap, class-specific underperformance, and abstention calibration before any deployment decision.
llm_issues: Severe validation-to-test generalization gap: val_acc 0.9972 → test_acc 0.8879 (~11 pp); val_macro_f1 0.9972 → test_macro_f1 0.8555 (~14 pp); selection criterion (val accuracy 0.9827) does not reflect test performance
Cancer-associated stroma (class 7) critically underperforming: recall 0.508, F1 0.647; 105/421 misclassified as debris, 71 as smooth muscle
Smooth muscle (class 5) underperforming: F1 0.705, recall 0.799; 61/592 misclassified as background, 42 as debris
Debris (class 2) low precision 0.614; 105 samples from class 7 and 42 from class 5 incorrectly assigned to debris
Adipose (class 0) recall only 0.843; 178/1338 misclassified as smooth muscle, 23 as adenocarcinoma
Test abstention rate 43.9% vs. validation 20%: ~24 pp coverage drop from the 80% calibration target; nearly half of test predictions deferred to human review
OOD evaluation limited to unit-scale Gaussian noise at 3 severity levels; does not cover semantic OOD shifts (tissue type variation, imaging artifacts, domain shift)
17 artefacts omitted from dossier (best_configuration, train_config, all trial artefacts, search_plan, split_manifest, data_profile, run_manifest, etc.), reducing full auditability
Rationale strings truncated in best_configuration, train_config, and trial configs (end with '…'), reducing full auditability of design justification
early_stopping_patience changed from 1 (search trials) to 3 (final training) without explicit in-rationale documentation of the deliberate escalation
reporting_status.complete_through_stage is 'comparison' rather than 'reporting', creating ambiguity about whether the reporting stage itself is marked complete
No statistical significance test (e.g., paired bootstrap CI or McNemar test) reported on the 7,180-sample test set to formally confirm the 6.66 pp accuracy delta is non-random
No per-class delta decomposition in comparison report to show whether improvement is uniform or concentrated in specific classes
